Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meenakshi - 40 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Rishabh - 9 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
4. Savitri - 66 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Riya - 13 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Meenakshi, Rishabh and Riya stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ishaan types on his laptop.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

[Ishaan watches cartoons on TV.]

Rishabh: "Riya, listen!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Night

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Ishaan, look over here."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Meenakshi (excited): "Hmm, I see."

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Ishaan: "That was such a fun day!"
